City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 20, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Arbor Day Proclamation
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the February 6, 2019 Special Meeting, February 6, 2019 Special Joint Meeting and March 6, 2019 Special Planning Session Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-03-20 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-03-20 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Resolution 2019-20, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas in support for the City of Imperial Beach and other partnering agencies in their effort to improve the water quality and reduce the transboundary flows of trash and debris in the Tijuana River Valley." Contact Person: Executive Assistant to City Council Clisby
1) Adopt Resolution 2019-20, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas in support for the City of Imperial Beach and other partnering agencies in their effort to improve the water quality and reduce the transboundary flows of trash and debris in the Tijuana River Valley"; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to send a cover letter and the resolution to Assemblymember Tasha Boerner Horvath, California 76th Assembly District, Senator Patricia Bates, California 36th Senate District, Kristin Gaspar, San Diego County 3rd Supervisorial District, Assemblymember Todd Gloria, California 78th Assembly District, Senator Ben Hueso, California 40th Senate District, Greg Cox, San Diego County 1st Supervisorial District, Governor Gavin Newson, Representative Mike Levin, California 49th Congressional District, Representative Juan Vargas, California 51st Congressional District, Senator Dianne Feinstein and Senator Kamala Harris.
2019-03-20 Item 08C Resolution 2019-20
8D.
Contract with Davis Farr LLP to provide professional auditing services to the City of Encinitas (City) and the San Dieguito Water District (SDWD). Contact Person: Finance Analyst Attili
Authorize the City Manager or her designee in coordination with the City Attorney to execute a professional services contract in substantial form with Davis Farr LLP to perform audit services for Fiscal Years (FY) 2018-19 through 2020-21 with an option to extend two additional one-year periods for a total term of five-years and a not-to-exceed cost of $274,900.
2019-03-20 Item 08D Contract with Davis Farr LLP to Provide Professional Audit Services
8E.
Environmental Commission Recommendation to City Council to Adopt a Resolution Supporting H.R. 763 – Energy Innovation and Carbon Dividend Act of 2019. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt City Council Resolution 2019-21, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Supporting H.R. 763 – Energy Innovation and Carbon Dividend Act of 2019”.
2019-03-20 Item 08E HR 763 Energy Innovation and Carbon Dividend Act of 2019
8F.
Bonita Drive Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS19C) Bid Solicitation. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
Authorize staff to solicit construction bids for the Bonita Drive Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS19C).
2019-03-20 Item 08F Bonita Drive Sidewalks Design
8G.
Approval of City Council Resolution No. 2019-07 to support the legalization of ferrets as domesticated pets in the State of California. Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
Approve City Council Resolution No. 2019-07, titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas In Support of Those Seeking Legalization of Domestic Ferrets in the State of California.”
2019-03-20 Item 08G Resolution No 2019-07 Ferrets
8H.
Agreement to Share Costs of Carlsbad Watershed Management Area (CWMA) Monitoring and Assessment Requirements. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute, on behalf of the City of Encinitas, the Agreement to Share Costs of Carlsbad Watershed Management Area Monitoring and Assessment Requirements.
2019-03-20 Item 08H Carlsbad Watershed Management Area (CWMA) Monitoring Cost Sharing Agreement
8I.
Summary vacations of a two-foot irrevocable offer of dedication, of a three-foot roadway easement, and a portion of public road right-of-way adjacent to 1368 and 1408 Caudor Street along Olympus Street. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Nowak (Address corrected on 3/15/19)
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-24 approving the summary vacations of an unused two-foot irrevocable offer of dedication, a three-foot roadway easement and a portion of road right-of-way adjacent to 1368 and 1408 Caudor Street along Olympus Street.
2019-03-20 Item 08I Caudor-Olympus Vacation
8J.
Agreement to share the cost of California Community Choice Association (CalCCA) Affiliate Membership. Contact Person: Program Administrator Najera
It is recommended that City Council take the following actions: 1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a cost agreement with the Cities of Oceanside, Carlsbad and Del Mar in substantial form to pay for CalCCA Affiliate Membership in an amount not to exceed $4,500 for a term of one year with two additional optional years.
2019-03-20 Item 08J CalCCA Membership
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Downtown Street Tree In-fill Program. Contact Person: City Arborist Kallstrand
Council take the following actions: 1) Review the proposed Downtown Street Tree In-Fill Program optional planting programs; 2) Affirm the recommendation of the UFAC subcommittee and City staff to proceed with Option 1 - Drought Tolerant Planting Program; and 3) Direct staff to proceed with an update to the Downtown Specific Plan to address the suitable tree palate.
2019-03-20 Item 10A Downtown Street Tree In-fill Program Agenda Report
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING POSSIBLE FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2019-03-20 Item 14 City Manager Follow Up Log
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MARCH 27, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
